slots.name: age at death
slots.sentence: musical legend Dolly Parton who has died at the age of 80.

slots.name: death date
slots.sentence: But for many, her death Tuesday has served as a reminder that at the heart of her legacy is her role as a songwriter.

events.label: Dolly Parton streams surge after death

slots.name: US stream increase
slots.sentence: audio and video streams of Parton’s discography skyrocketed 2,458% on the day of her death, compared to Monday — climbing from 1.2 million to 30.5 million in the U.S.

slots.name: US stream total
slots.sentence: And by Wednesday, that number rose to 46.3 million.

slots.name: worldwide stream increase
slots.sentence: Worldwide, her audio and video streams jumped 1,549%, from 2.5 million on Monday to 41.8 million Tuesday.

slots.name: Jolene streams
slots.sentence: 1. “Jolene” grew from over 196.2K streams on Monday to 3.3 million Tuesday and 4 million Wednesday.

slots.name: 9 to 5 streams
slots.sentence: 2. “9 to 5” jumped from 208.6K on Monday to 3.0 million on Tuesday and 3.6 million on Wednesday.

slots.name: Islands streams
slots.sentence: 3. “Islands in the Stream,” her duet with the late Kenny Rogers, climbed from 165.9K on Monday to 2.1 million Tuesday and 2.9 million Wednesday.

slots.name: I Will Always streams
slots.sentence: 4. “I Will Always Love You,” Parton’s performance of her own classic, a song that was later made famous by Whitney Houston’s rendition, rose from 64.9K streams on Monday to 2.0 million Tuesday and 2.8 million Wednesday.

slots.name: Here You Come streams
slots.sentence: 5. “Here You Come Again” followed, moving from 48.7K streams Monday to 1.5 million Tuesday to 2.1 million Wednesday.

slots.name: Coat streams
slots.sentence: 6. Then there was “Coat of Many Colors,” with 28.9K streams Monday to 1.3 million Tuesday and 1.9 million Wednesday.

slots.name: Why’d You Come streams
slots.sentence: 7. “Why’d You Come In Here Lookin’ Like That?” climbed from 22.1K Monday to 827K Tuesday and 1.3 million Wednesday.

slots.name: There Was Jesus streams
slots.sentence: 8. “There Was Jesus,” her 2019 duet with Christian singer Zach Williams, rose from 85.2K streams Monday to 635.1K Tuesday and 682.0K Wednesday.

slots.name: Tennessee Home streams
slots.sentence: 10. “Tyrant,” Parton’s collaboration with Beyoncé from Bey’s Grammy winning 2024 album “Cowboy Carter,” jumped from 47.8K Monday to 559.2K Tuesday and 755.5K Wednesday.

slots.name: Tyrant streams
slots.sentence: As of early Friday afternoon, three Parton books were in the top 5 on Amazon.com ’s bestseller list.

slots.name: global streaming rank
slots.sentence: And on Wednesday, her on-demand audio streams jumped to 79.7 million, making her the most streamed artist, globally, on that date.
